title: tzsp: use a dissector table for the encapsulated protocols
description:
The tzsp dissector uses a switch(encap) to decide what dissector to call
next to process the payload, so adding a new encapsulation type requires
modifying the tzsp dissector.

Change it to use a dissector table; this lets other dissectors, plugins,
or Lua scripts easily add other non-standard encapsulation IDs.

---

I made this change after a request on Discord, but I didn't submit it, and then it sat on my local repo for almost exactly a year. I'm finally catching up now...
